targetYaml:
version: 1
kind: target
name: lab1
core:
    amf: ${LAB_AMF}
    plmn:
        mcc: "208"
        mnc: "93"
    slices:
        - sst: 1
          sd: "010203"
subscribers:
    - name: main
      first_supi: "208930100007500"
      count: 10
      ki: ${ORBIT_KI}
      opc: ${ORBIT_OPC}
ran:
    n2_source_ips:
        - 127.0.0.1
        - 127.0.0.2
    n3_ips:
        - 127.0.0.1
    gnb_ids:
        first: 7
        bits: 24
runYaml:
# The conformance suite with an expected-failures list inline: the mock
# core's reset on an unknown UE is tolerated, the other FAIL is not.
kind: run
workloads:
  - name: conformance
    conformance:
      categories: [negative-ie]
      per_test_timeout_ms: 3000
      expected:
        core: mockamf
        version: test
        entries:
          - check: NGAP-UNKNOWN-UE-SURVIVES
            observed: association reset
            finding: EX-1
            added: 2026-10-28
            reason: "example: the mock core resets the association"
gates:
  - name: conformance
    conformance: true
